logp.method_description: N-octanol-water partition coefficient was determined by the shake-flask method. PBS buffered distilled water (100 mL, phosphate buffer [PO43 -] = 10 mM, 0.15 M NaCl, pH 7.4) and 100 mL of n-octanol shaken together for 72 h to allow saturation of both phases. Approximately 1 mg of the complex was mixed in 5 mL of aqueous and organic phase, respectively for 10 min. The resultant emulsion was centrifuged to separate the phases. The concentration of the compound in each phase was determined using UV absorbance spectroscopy. LogD7.4 was defined as log{[compound(organic)]/[compound(aqueous)]}.
